rules.description: Version/edition gating that must not exist in this open-source build
Reference to a gated/paid-only DSP capability name
Internal version/repair marker that belongs in a changelog, not source comments
Internal review/audit finding tag (single letter + number, e.g. M-2, L-6). Test-case IDs like BC-001 are exempt.
Provenance marker leaking that a file was copied from another internal tree
rules.pattern: \bPorted from|adapted from the OSS|from the OSS\b|\bOSS test suite|\bOSS suite\b|\bOSS build\b|\bOSS 40|sibling OSS|from the OS test suite|OSS test

rules.description: Prose reference to an internal review finding / gate-audit verdict
Copyright header whose holder is not the project's canonical studio name
Non-English (CJK) comment left in source/markup (this repo keeps source comments in English)
Wording that implies a fuller paid edition or an anti-piracy mechanism
Reference to an internal numbered planning/review doc from source

allowlist.reason: Language-combobox display name for the Chinese locale; legitimate UI text
Anti-leak guard test: asserts the effect name is not registered in this build
Anti-leak guard: default chain must not contain that effect name
Standard Apache-2.0 clause wording ('commercial damages'); license boilerplate
Objective description of a third-party driver; not product commercial info
Bilingual UI-label arrays: FlaUI must match the strings the app renders in the active locale, so these CJK literals are test data rather than comments
Same bilingual label-matching data; scoped to the array declarations so CJK left in a comment in these files still fails the gate
